Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.1: Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Oral Presentations
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Oral Presentations, part of Strand 10 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How can you make a speech presentation interesting? 2. What are some of the techniques for introducing or concluding a speech?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 10.1.1 Oral Presentations together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: It is inculcated as the learner works in groups to discuss the format of a speech.

• Learning to learn: It is developed as the learner organises their own learning and acquire speech presentation skills.

Values:
• Respect: It is enhanced as the learner listens to peers speeches and respect each other’s opinions.

• Unity: It is enhanced as the learner collaborates with peers while engaging in conversations.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion: It is improved as the learner are presenting a speech on art thus making learners appreciate their heritage

Link to other Learning Areas:

Public speaking is a concept relevant in performance of various genres in Creative arts and sports and sports
